name: Fireworks
summary: Serverless inference with your own API key. Account quotas are separate from prepaid credit balance; starter credit and model access need account verification.

credentials.label: Fireworks API key
credentials.help: Create your own Fireworks API key. This serverless route does not use Fire Pass keys.

credentials.label: Fireworks account ID (quota monitor)
credentials.help: For quota monitoring, copy the account ID from the Fireworks account settings; do not enter a user ID, display name, or model owner account.

setupSteps.title: Create an API key
setupSteps.description: Create a key in your own account and enter it privately in lain.

setupSteps.title: Check the available credit
setupSteps.description: Check starter-credit eligibility, expiry, and billing before inference. No dedicated deployment or purchase is required by this connector.

setupSteps.title: Optional quota monitor
setupSteps.description: Enter the Fireworks account ID. The key must be allowed to list that account’s quotas; if necessary, configure a separate authorized API key for the monitor.

billingPlans.name: Starter credit (if granted)
billingPlans.notes: The FAQ describes $1 starter credit. Actual allocation, balance and expiry are unverified; this is not a recurring free tier.

billingPlans.name: Serverless pay as you go
billingPlans.notes: Uses account credits or the existing billing arrangement. No purchase, Auto Reload or paid fallback is enabled by lain.

routes.name: GLM 5.3 Flash · serverless

sources.title: Serverless quickstart and API key setup

restrictions: The full model resource ID is required. Current official quickstart documents this serverless model; availability on this account is unverified.
Starter credit is not an enforceable free-only route. No automatic fallback to another model or budget.
Tools and model context/output limits have not been qualified for this route.

sources.title: Serverless quickstart and API key setup
Quota types and monthly spend scope

restrictions: Gateway and quota access are separate capabilities; a quota permission error does not invalidate inference access.
The quota API reports account constraints, not remaining prepaid credit. Unknown quota units remain unknown.
Monthly spend usage can lag; no quota reset is inferred from updateTime.
Fire Pass, dedicated deployments, purchases and external billing-history import are outside this connector.
Local fixtures do not prove live provider access.
